Note 9. Debt

As of June 30, 2025, the Company was not in compliance with the quick ratio covenant under the Credit Agreement, as its quick ratio of 0.62 was below the minimum of 0.65 required. On August 5, 2025, the Company obtained a waiver from the lender for this covenant violation. As of June 30, 2025, the Company was in compliance with all other covenants under the Credit Agreement and the Term Loan, including the fixed charge coverage ratio and the leverage ratio.
